title: Fe(110) site and vacancy evidence at the selected C1-C2 endpoints
scope: One metallic Fe(110) benchmark surface. No interface is present in these states. Inventory IDs remain unassigned across all reactions. R4 internal minima are included for the H-migration sequence.

method.atom_indices: zero-based within each bound structure; Fe36-44 exposed on the clean slab
method.geometry_projection: Nearest clean reference center in the slab plane using the repository Fe(110) projector. The one, two or three nearest exposed reference Fe specify its identity, not its occupancy. Off-symmetry uses the recorded 0.45 A cutoff. Quantities rounded to six decimals.
method.structure_identity: All ten endpoint/intermediate file hashes verified. Cells match the clean reference; the bottom 18 Fe coordinates match under in-plane periodic wrapping within 1e-6 A. R2 FS uses the geometry-verified archived POSCAR copy of its final CONTCAR.
method.fragment_basis: Selected endpoint species and state-specific atom maps were checked against actual elements and all intralayer adsorbate-pair distances. Molecular identity does not determine occupancy. Projections use candidate C/O anchors or free atomic H. Bonded H and the O end of intact CO are retained in atom lists rather than treated as independent surface sites.
method.physical_contacts: Four nearest relaxed Fe atoms per candidate anchor given as geometric distances (minimum image in x,y; no z wrap). No binding cutoff or charge partitioning is assumed. Center overlaps give only common indices on the clean reference lattice.

confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.CO: R1 IS projects C onto top Fe41; R3 IS projects C onto long bridge Fe39/41. Site-specific CO configurations, diffusion/equilibration or distinct species may be needed; a universal CO footprint has no approval.
confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.C: In R1 FS and R2 IS the carbon projects onto long bridge Fe43/44, with different coadsorbates. The local C coordination shell includes additional Fe and does not define multidentate occupancy.
confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.O: R1 FS O46 projects onto hollow Fe40/42/43, sharing Fe43 with the neighboring C bridge. The exclusion rule for overlapping centers is unresolved.
confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.H: R2 IS and R4 IS/INT06/MID have free H at different hollow centers. R4 arrival produces an O-H group; covalently bound H atoms are not independently supplied H* molecules.
confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.CH: C45 projects onto a long bridge in R2 FS and R3 IS. H belongs to the molecule; evidenced CH configurations on two neighboring clean-reference Fe are candidates for one bridge ensemble, subject to researcher confirmation.
confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.CHCO: Two carbon projections land in separate hollows which share Fe. O has a nearby Fe contact; off-symmetry O projection is not an independent site count. Review one composite ensemble versus two coupled hollows and the role of O.
confirmed_geometry_and_unresolved_specie.C2H2O: R4 FS-A is the selected O-hydrogenated product, O47-H49 about 0.981 A. Two carbon projections share Fe38/41; O47 nearest Fe40 is 2.842 A and class unknown in the archived endpoint geometry review. A single composite ensemble and multiple coupled carbon centers are plausible model choices. No separate O or H site is established by projection.

archived_coordination_review.meaning: The archived C/H coordination-shell review used one-based Fe38. Projected long-bridge/hollow center support sets do not overlap. Geometric neighbors and inventory exclusions have separate meanings.

inventory_rule: For each confirmed physical inventory j, sum reactant molecular coefficients times footprint ij plus confirmed vacancy consumption equals sum product coefficients times footprint ij plus confirmed release. Confirm excluded neighboring ensembles separately if shared Fe makes them mutually exclusive. All residuals remain null until both sides and the inventory basis are specified.
charge_rule: Species formal charges and any reservoir/electron convention are unknown in the selected network. A neutral periodic supercell and C/H/O atom balance cannot establish the per-species charge balance. Evidence can confirm neutral-species bookkeeping explicitly where appropriate.
review_requests: Name the surface inventories and specify whether overlapping, neighboring or symmetry-equivalent projected centers are distinct, mutually exclusive, or pooled.
Choose per-configuration molecular footprints, including the composite CHCO and C2H2O alternatives, the oxygen contact and each shared-Fe exclusion rule. Resolve R1 top CO versus R3 bridge CO.
Provide vacancy consumption and release separately for each inventory and direction. Confirm genuine zero explicitly; equation asterisks have no inventory ID.
Provide the charge bookkeeping basis and any reservoir terms. The existing R3 confirmation template, or a scoped site-mapping decision with provenance, can carry the supported parts.
independence: All ten reviewed structures and these researcher decisions are independent of the pending R4 frequency job. No new DFT, frequency or NEB is required to make this model choice; additional evidence may be needed to validate a chosen exclusion rule or a new physical configuration.
